Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot

Class SpringBootEventHandler<I,O>

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot.SpringBootEventHandler<I,O>
Type Parameters:
I - input type
O - output type (ignored for events)
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEndpoint
public abstract class SpringBootEventHandler<I,O> extends Object implements EventEndpoint
Base class for exposing an event-triggered Cloudhopper function as a Spring Boot endpoint, POST /events/<function name>.

The request follows the CloudEvents HTTP binding in binary mode: the body is the event data (for a queue, the message as JSON; for a bucket, {"bucket": ..., "key": ..., "size": ...}, where bucket defaults to the name in the annotation), and the optional headers ce-id, ce-source and ce-time fill the EventMetadata; other ce-* headers become its attributes. A successful invocation answers 204 No Content; an exception answers with an error status, so that the caller can deliver the event again.

      public void deliver(String body, Map<String,String> headers, int deliveryAttempt) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: EventEndpoint
      Invokes the function for one event. Delivery is at least once: when this method throws, the caller delivers the event again.
      Specified by:
      deliver in interface EventEndpoint
      Parameters:
      body - the event data, or null
      headers - CloudEvents attributes as ce-<name> headers; ce-id, ce-source and ce-time fill the metadata, the others become its attributes
      deliveryAttempt - how often the event has been delivered, starting at 1; 0 if unknown
      Throws:
      IOException - if the body is not valid JSON for the input type
